chunks: Our rational and narrational arguments that the earth does not remain devoid of an Imam also invalidates this assertion.
ai.seo_question: How does the continuous presence of an Imam invalidate opposing theological assertions?
ai.summary: Al-Tusi reinforces the doctrine of *Hujjiyyat al-'Aql* (authority of reason) alongside *Shar'* (divine law) to demonstrate that the world cannot be devoid of an Imam, thereby refuting the claim of the Imam's absence or death. This passage is pivotal in establishing the necessity of a living, guiding Imam during the Minor and Major Gheebah, ensuring the continuity of divine proof (*Hujjah*) for humanity.
